title: Blinded evidence-grounding calibration set
purpose: Evaluate typed path support, licensed text support, and therapeutic plausibility as separate labels rather than folding them into Recall or MRR.
annotation_basis: A small, frozen research calibration set initially annotated from the typed query semantics and cited Europe PMC excerpts, then independently reviewed and conservatively adjudicated within the cited source scope. It is not clinical expert consensus and must not be used as medical advice.

label_provenance.graph_path_support: Source-scoped programmatic label from the frozen training graph; not biomedical-review adjudicated.
label_provenance.evidence_support: Independent reviewer adjudicated against the frozen CC BY Europe PMC manifest and excerpt scope.
label_provenance.therapeutic_plausibility: Independent reviewer adjudicated conservatively within the cited source scope; this is not clinical consensus.

labels.graph_path_support: Whether the query's typed path is present in the training graph; held-out target edges are expected to be false.
labels.therapeutic_plausibility: Reviewer-adjudicated as supported_in_source_scope, plausible_but_species_or_preclinical_limited, not_supported_as_epilepsy_therapy, or insufficient_evidence, always bounded by the cited source.

annotations.rationale: The cited record names zonisamide as a treatment for epileptic seizures in dogs; the species boundary prevents a human clinical-utility claim.
